# Opaque runtime fixture

These are unqualified synthetic template-package sources for the real catalog runtime
controls. There is no language project, package dependency, post-action or script in the
archive. Symbols intentionally preserve awkward raw names, an explicit package identity,
an independent code identifier, empty values and literal metacharacters. The provider
skill tests the existing SDD mirror authority. Archive construction and actual isolated
install/create are separately selected; this source directory is no runtime observation.

Candidate 1.0.1 explicitly declares `packageIdentity`. Candidate 1.0.0 and its raw
archive are preserved privately: SDK 10.0.401 generated `--param:package` for its
`package` key, so the required literal `--package` invocation refused. Production
must refuse such transport alias changes. The nonempty `empty` default remains;
only actual empty-argv creation with exact empty output can qualify substitution.
